lyrics.text: Penso che un sogno così non ritorni mai più
lyrics.translation: I think that such a dream will never return again

lyrics.text: Mi dipingevo le mani e la faccia di blu
lyrics.translation: I painted my hands and my face in blue

lyrics.text: Poi d'improvviso venivo dal vento rapito
lyrics.translation: Then suddenly I was snatched by the wind

lyrics.text: E incominciavo a volare nel cielo infinito
lyrics.translation: And I began to fly in the infinite sky
To sing, oh, oh, oh, oh
